overview_description.description:
Mr Usta Turkey is a technology-driven service platform that connects customers with skilled professionals across a wide range of home, maintenance, and technical service categories. The company focuses on delivering fast, reliable, and high-quality solutions designed to simplify everyday life for both individual and business customers.

Through its website and mobile application, users can conveniently schedule appointments at their preferred time, make secure credit card payments with installment options, and quickly access qualified professionals for services such as electrical work, air conditioning and boiler maintenance, moving assistance, upholstery and carpet cleaning, dry cleaning, shoe care, architectural design, and renovation projects.

Beyond serving consumers, Mr Usta also supports businesses in the e-commerce, furniture, and real estate industries by offering after-sales assembly, store setup, installation, and technical support services.

With an inclusive, innovative, and results-oriented approach, Mr Usta Turkey continues to expand its service ecosystem while creating new work opportunities for skilled professionals and enhancing customer convenience through technology-enabled service delivery.
